items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: He did the dancing and I did the singing, Buck did the playing.

ctx.x: No. He danced on the same stage. I was a singer on the same stage. We appeared on the same stage, but we
didn't dance on the same stage. He did the dancing and I did the singing, Buck did the playing. We never come into conflict dancing.
